'''Do Zonn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Do Zonn was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Zonn was stationed on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. While still a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Zonn had traveled into the ruins of the fortress city [[Kaleth]] and had a brief encounter with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Redeeming himself in the eyes of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Zonn was made a Knight and appointed as the defender of the ruins where he advised other Jedi who traveled within. Though studying from afar, Jedi Zonn was able to gather significant data on the [[Chamber of Speech]], an ancient cavern hidden in the hills in upper Kaleth.<ref name="TheChamberofSpeech" />

==Behind the scenes==
Do Zonn appears in the mission "Chamber of Speech" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
